dispositions.topic_text: Evidence required for the security review to be complete, including strengthened A19 tests
Test guarantee that a query value cannot alter URL or parameter structure
Test guarantee that a statement causes only the intended store effect
Canonical owner-interface rendering of every non-text stored value
dispositions.what: The text a non-text stored value (a number, a decimal, an instant, a date, a member of an enumeration, a bool) is shown as on an owner page; every option keeps that text escaped for its place, never markup or script.
keeps:
The owner interface renders every stored value as text: escaped for the
   place it appears in, never as markup or script, whoever wrote it.
options: Declare one canonical textual representation per domain type.
Permit each page to choose localized or human-facing formatting.
consequences: Canonical forms are stable across pages and locales.
Generic conversion inherits the implementation language's conventions.
Page-local formatting requires explicit locale, time-zone and consistency decisions while still preserving A19's escaping guarantee.
